rainGauges.method: gauge: accumulator increments binned by the UTC hour containing the report (MST+7); an hour with no report on either side is unknown (null), never zero. Window totals: gauge and Stage IV cell summed over the same known gauge hours; gaugeTotal*IsLowerBound marks a gauge with unknown hours in the window. model: B precip_2d.nc frame whose interval START is that hour, sampled bilinearly with the solver grid rule; corrByLag k = correlation of gauge hour h with model frame h-k (k>0: model rain would need to be LATER to match)
